pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Bug fix matching the PR words: a search with no matches says no item matches; an empty table still says 'No items yet.'. No extra behaviour found.
No spec file in this change.

Three new tests in test/search.test.js cover the no-match message, escaping, and the empty-table case. Each would fail against the old code or a wrong fix. test/apply-migrations.js resets the DB before every test, so the DELETE in the third test does not leak. I did not run the tests; CI runs them.
README.md and CLAUDE.md do not mention the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The message is chosen correctly. A search on an empty table gets 'No items yet.'. The extra COUNT query only runs when a search finds nothing.
The search term is escaped with escapeHtml in the new message, and a test checks it. The template inserts the message unescaped, but the only value in it that comes from the user is already escaped.
The change adds no UI files. It only changes a server-rendered message string.
